ev.q: This report compares obesity prevalence among children in New York City and Los Angeles County
In 2011, the obesity prevalence among Hispanics in NYC was 19.1%, compared with 21.7% in LAC.
Obesity was defined as an age- and sex-specific BMI at or above the 95th reference percentile
The prevalence of obesity by age, race/ethnicity, and geographic area was calculated for each year from 2003 to 2011.
Hispanic WIC-enrolled children had the greatest prevalence of obesity for all years in both areas
However, by 2005, obesity prevalence in LAC had exceeded NYC for both age groups
From 2003 to 2009, the prevalence of obesity decreased among NYC WIC-enrolled children aged 3 or 4 years
All data for this study were extracted from New York and California WIC administrative data systems for the period 2003–2011.
